description_en: Queries the running status of a pipeline node
description_zh: 获取工作流任务节点运行状态
kebab_example: aliyun paiflow list-pipeline-run-node-status --pipeline-run-id flow-rbvg5wzljzjhc90000 --node-id node-kdkfkfds0000 --depth 2 --type Logical --token-id 'https://pai.console.aliyun.com/0regionId=cn-hangzhou_workspaceId=102000000_mode=noSidebar#/paiflow/pipeline-runs/flow-6y70000000Token=eyJ0e000000' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPipelineRunNodeStatus

parameters.description_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call [ListPipelineRuns](~~438042~~) to obtain the ID of the pipeline job.

parameters.description_en: The depth at which information about the node is queried. If you set Depth to N, the information about the node and all its child nodes at the N-1 layer is returned.
parameters.description_zh: 查询节点深度，当深度为N时，返回指定节点的N-1层子节点运行状态。

parameters.help_zh: 查询节点深度，当深度为N时，返回指定节点的N-1层子节点运行状态

parameters.description_en:
The node type. Valid values:

- Logical (default): the logical node. The nodes submitted by users are logical nodes.

- Physical: the physical node on which a container is deployed for executing specific logic. A logical node is converted to a physical node when the logical node runs in the background.
parameters.description_zh:
节点类型，取值如下：
* Logical（默认值）：表示逻辑节点，用户提交节点的都是逻辑节点。
* Physical：表示物理节点，对应一个执行特定逻辑的容器的运行，逻辑节点在后台运行时会转换为物理节点。
